description: This is an Android Java source file that implements an Activity demonstrating ListView item animations, handling view recycling issues during animations, and providing options for setting transient state during animations.

classes.name: ListViewAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating animated interactions with ListView items, including handling view recycling issues and transient state management.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter that provides stable IDs for items in the list to maintain item consistency across changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ListView with data, and defines item click behavior including animations.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for an item, based on its position, ensuring consistent identification.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that the adapter uses stable IDs for its items.
